report:
Ear, right aural polyp, resection

Received in formalin is a polypoid piece of tissue labelled right aural polyp, measuring 0.6 x 0.4 x 0.3 cm. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Polyp, all embedded.

Sections show a polypoid fragment of granulation tissue with numerous small blood vessels and a chronic inflammatory infiltrate of lymphocytes, plasma cells and histiocytes. The surface is ulcerated. Features are those of an aural polyp. There is no evidence of malignancy.

EAR, right aural polyp, resection - AURAL POLYP
